prose.text: Shift leads need a daily report showing short picks per picker so they can target retraining and reduce errors.
Sam builds the report manually in Excel from WMS exports, taking about four hours every Monday morning.
Automate a daily report per picker, per shift, per day, ready by 6am, counting short picks as defined.
No customer or pricing data is used; over picks are not included in the report.
If the automated report disagrees with WMS for two weeks, Sam will switch it off and revert to the manual spreadsheet.

acceptance.given: WMS pick confirmations are available and the report is generated by 6am
acceptance.when: the report matches the short pick counts as defined and is delivered to shift leads
acceptance.then: shift leads use it to target retraining decisions

acceptance.given: the report disagrees with WMS pick confirmations for two consecutive weeks
acceptance.then: the automated report is switched off and the manual process resumes

guardrails.text: If the report disagrees with WMS two weeks in a row, it is switched off and replaced by the manual spreadsheet.
Manual spreadsheet process resumes if the automated report is switched off.
